title: Rationally designed In–CeO2/g-C3N4 S-scheme heterojunction photocatalyst with tuned redox ability for the photocatalytic degradation of pharmaceutical contaminants
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47271-47281
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07023F, Paper

Mazen R. Alrahili, Mohamed Abdel Rafea, Magdi E. A. Zaki, M. Khairy, Mohamed R. El-Aassar, Sultan Albarakati, Imran Shakir, Abdullah K. Alanazi, Muhammad Aadil
The S-scheme In–CeO2/g-C3N4 heterojunction achieves enhanced photocatalytic degradation of levofloxacin by preserving strong redox carriers and promoting the efficient generation of ˙OH and ˙O2− radicals under visible light.
